channel.title: Echo Prime Technologies
channel.description: Technical blog and changelog from Echo Prime Technologies — AI engineering, intelligence engines, oilfield tech, tax intelligence, and autonomous systems.

item.title: Why Intelligence Engines Beat Chatbot Wrappers for Enterprise AI
item.description: Most AI platforms are thin wrappers around ChatGPT. Intelligence engines embed real domain expertise — doctrine-backed reasoning with 697K+ blocks across 5,400+ engines. Here's why the difference matters for enterprise decisions.

item.title: How AI is Transforming Title Examination in the Permian Basin
item.description: Traditional title examination in the Permian Basin takes 40-80 hours per section. AI-powered chain-of-title analysis with 259K+ deed records and automated gap detection cuts that to hours, not weeks.

item.title: Building Autonomous AI Agents That Actually Work in Production
item.description: The gap between demo AI agents and production AI agents is enormous. Here's how we run 100+ autonomous Workers on Cloudflare with self-healing, circuit breakers, and zero downtime.

item.title: MACRS Depreciation Optimization with AI Tax Engines
item.description: MACRS depreciation is one of the most powerful tax optimization tools available. Our AI tax engines analyze asset classifications, bonus depreciation eligibility, and cost segregation opportunities with IRC-backed reasoning.

item.title: Zero-Trust Security Architecture for AI-First Companies
item.description: When your AI processes sensitive business data across 100+ microservices, traditional perimeter security fails. Here's how we implement zero-trust with HMAC verification, rate limiting, and defense-in-depth.

item.title: Running 100+ Microservices on Cloudflare Workers: Architecture Lessons
item.description: We run 100+ Cloudflare Workers in production — service bindings, D1 databases, KV caches, R2 storage, Durable Objects. Here are the architectural patterns and hard-won lessons from building at scale on the edge.
